mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Over at Fireman's Park, we are starting the day with overcast skies and a temperature of 78 degrees that feels like 82, all under a Waxing Crescent moon.

The City of Verona continues to focus on sustainability and transportation. Apartment residents can drop off food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue, and the city has successfully maintained its Bronze Level Bicycle Friendly Community designation.

There are several exciting events coming up, including live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's on July 18th. Also, look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on July 22nd.

In police updates, on Thursday, July 9th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash with injuries at County Highway PB and American Way, resulting in one driver being transported to a hospital and another being cited.
Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10:00 AM with today's delicious Mint Cookie flavor of the day. If you cannot make it, tomorrow's mouth-watering flavor will be Turtle.
